title: Migraine may leave bodywide clues, AI analysis of 43,000 people suggests
description: A new study from NTNU—the Norwegian University of Science and Technology—reveals that migraine may leave a biological pattern throughout the body, traces of which can be identified by artificial intelligence. Researchers used AI to analyze information gathered from more than 43,000 participants during a countywide health survey, Helseundersøkelsen i Trøndelag (HUNT).

title: New Brunswick wants public feedback on data centre plan
description: A news release says the draft policy will support Canada's efforts to control its own data and develop Canadian artificial intelligence.
content:

title: S&P Global weighs multibillion-dollar spinout of Capital IQ Pro: Report
description: S&P Global is considering spinning off Capital IQ Pro into a standalone company that could be valued in the high single-digit billions of dollars, Bloomberg reported. The move could unlock value from its financial data platform as demand for proprietary data grows with artificial intelligence and reshape S&P Global's portfolio under CEO Martina Cheung.
